title: 第9章 赏罚

content_zh:
姜似神色坦然，任由姜老夫人打量。
前一世她虽然没活过二十岁，可是遭遇的那些不幸比寻常女子一辈子经历的还多，当然不惧别人打量。
姜安诚神色舒展：“既然似儿这么说，那为父就做主了，退亲！”
一声“退亲”说得中气十足，姜似心头攸地一松。
“不行！”冯老夫人声色俱厉喊道。
本来指望孙女拿捏住长子，谁知姜似的反常让冯老夫人的打算落了空，于是毫不犹豫撕开了温情的面纱，声音冷硬如刀：“我绝不同意退亲！”
“母亲！”
“你不要说了！你可知道能与安国公府定亲有多少人羡慕？别说大丫头、二丫头在婆家被高看一眼，这一年来上门给三丫头提亲的门第都比以前强了不少。说白了，还不是瞧中了能与安国公府沾亲。老大，你就算不为四丫头着想，也要为咱们伯府考虑一下！”
“母亲，您的意思是为了伯府，就可以牺牲似儿的终身幸福了？”姜安诚反问。
“混账，这样诛心的话你也说！”冯老夫人身子一晃，扶着额头往后倒去，身边的大丫鬟阿福手疾眼快扶住她。
“母亲，您没事吧？”姜安诚虽不满冯老夫人的做法，可看到她这样还是紧张起来。
冯老夫人冷冷瞪着姜安诚：“你这个不孝子，竟认为我为了伯府不顾四丫头的死活！难道她不是我孙女？四丫头嫁去安国公府明明对她与伯府都是极好的事，你却为了一时意气要退亲！”
“我不是因为意气——”
“住嘴！婚姻大事是父母之命，但似儿自幼没了母亲，难道我这当祖母的还做不得主？今天我就把话说明白了，安国公府理亏在先，你大可以为了似儿提些要求，但是退亲我不答应！”
冯老夫人一番话说得姜安诚心都是凉的，正要再劝，冯老夫人身边另一位大丫鬟阿喜匆匆跑了进来，气喘吁吁道：“老夫人，不好了，二公子，二公子他——”
“那孽障又惹了什么祸？”这个节骨眼上，姜安诚一听人提起姜湛头都大了，若是姜湛就站在他面前恨不得踢死拉倒。
阿喜面色发白：“二公子把停在咱们府门外的安国公府的马车给砸了！”
“什么？”冯老夫人头也不晕了，腾地站了起来。
姜安诚的怒火一下子烟消云散。
嗯，干得漂亮，混账儿子偶尔还是干点人事的。

“管事是吃闲饭的吗？还不赶紧阻止他！”
“老夫人，阻不住啊，二公子往咱们这边来了，管事不好带着人追——”
“来这里？”冯老夫人眼中闪过迷惑。
莫非那混账是来负荆请罪的？
冯老夫人很快发现自己想多了，又一名丫鬟奔进来禀报：“老夫人，二公子正往花厅里闯呢，婢子们快拦不住了！”
冯老夫人眼前阵阵发黑，这下子是真想晕了。
“跟我过去！”冯老夫人剜了姜安诚一眼，匆匆往花厅赶去。
“二公子，您不能进去啊，里面有贵客呢。”
姜湛一蹦三尺高：“我呸，什么贵客？侮辱我妹妹的人家算哪门子贵客？给我让开！”
姜湛一脚踹飞拦在他身前的丫鬟，半点没有怜香惜玉的觉悟。
安国公世子夫人郭氏已经惊呆了。
“你是安国公府的人？”
郭氏不由站了起来，若不是见冲过来的少年实在好看，怎么也和土匪沾不上边，早就拔腿飞奔了。
“我乃安国公世子夫人，你是何人？怎能如此无礼？”郭氏试图与美少年讲道理。
姜湛一听还是个重量级的，而且是在自己家里逮到的，不揍白不揍啊，抡起脚边小几就砸了过去。
郭氏尖叫一声，白眼一翻就要昏过去。
门口丫鬟喊了一声：“世子夫人，您不能昏啊，我们二公子闹起来拦不住的——”
郭氏一听打了个激灵，当下头也不昏了，腿也不打颤了，抬脚就跑。
小几砸在桌角上，发出一声巨响，桌角立刻断了一截。
姜湛拎着小几追了上去：“站住，欺负了我妹妹还想跑？”

“小畜生，你做什么？”冯老夫人匆匆赶来，见到姜湛追在郭氏后面跑的情景气得眩晕。
郭氏缓了口气。
总算等到东平伯老夫人来了。
轻柔的少女声音传来：“世子夫人，您还是赶紧回府吧，二公子疯起来老夫人也管不了，就算过后挨罚，当时造成的伤害也无法挽回呀。”

content_en:
Jiang Si looked calm and allowed Mrs. Jiang to look at her.
Although she did not live past the age of twenty in her previous life, she encountered more misfortunes than an ordinary woman would experience in a lifetime. Of course, she was not afraid of being judged by others.
Jiang Ancheng's expression relaxed: "Since Si'er said so, then it's my father's decision to cancel the engagement!"
The words "retire the engagement" were said with such force that Jiang Si felt relieved.
"No!" Madam Feng shouted in a stern voice.
She originally expected her granddaughter to take control of her eldest son, but Mrs. Feng's abnormality made Mrs. Feng's plan come to nothing. She did not hesitate to tear open the veil of tenderness and said in a voice as cold as a knife: "I will never agree to break off the engagement!"
"Mother!"
"Stop talking! Do you know how many people are envious of being engaged to Duke An Guo? Not to mention that the eldest girl and the second girl are looked down upon by her husband's family. In the past year, the family status of the third girl who came to propose marriage to the third girl has been much better than before. To put it bluntly, it is not just that you are attracted by the marriage with Duke An Guo. Boss, even if you don't think about the fourth girl, you must also think about our uncle's house!"
"Mother, do you mean to sacrifice Si'er's lifelong happiness for the sake of the uncle's house?" Jiang Ancheng asked back.
"Bastard, you can say such heartbreaking things!" Mrs. Feng swayed and fell backwards, holding her forehead. The maid Ah Fu next to her quickly supported her with quick hands and eyes.
"Mom, are you okay?" Although Jiang Ancheng was dissatisfied with Mrs. Feng's behavior, he still became nervous when he saw her like this.
Mrs. Feng stared at Jiang Ancheng coldly: "You unfilial son, you actually think that I don't care about the life and death of the fourth girl for the sake of the uncle's house! Isn't she my granddaughter? The fourth girl's marriage to Duke Anguo's house is obviously a great thing for her and the uncle's house, but you want to break off the engagement just for the sake of temporary satisfaction!"
"It's not because I'm angry——"
"Shut up! Marriage is an order of the parents, but Si'er has lost her mother since she was a child. Am I, a grandmother, still unable to make the decision? I'll make it clear today. Duke An Guo's government has done something wrong first. You can make some demands for Si'er, but I won't agree to withdraw from the engagement!"
Mrs. Feng's words made Jiang Ancheng feel cold. Just as he was about to persuade her again, Axi, another maid next to Mrs. Feng, hurried in and said breathlessly: "Old lady, it's not good, the second young master, the second young master -"
"What trouble did that villain cause?" At this juncture, Jiang Ancheng felt his head grow bigger when someone mentioned Jiang Zhan. If Jiang Zhan stood in front of him, he would have wanted to kick him to death.
Ah happy's face turned pale: "Second Young Master smashed the carriage of Duke An Guo's Mansion parked outside our house!"
"What?" Mrs. Feng stood up without feeling dizzy.
Jiang Ancheng's anger suddenly disappeared.
Well, good job, my bastard son still does some human things occasionally.
"Is the manager just a freeloader? Why don't you stop him quickly!"
"Old madam, we can't stop it. The second young master is coming towards us. It's not good for the steward to lead his men to chase him -"
"Come here?" Mrs. Feng's eyes flashed with confusion.
Could it be that that bastard is here to plead guilty?
Mrs. Feng soon realized that she was overthinking, and another maid rushed in to report: "Old Madam, the second young master is rushing into the flower hall, and the maids can hardly stop him!"
Madam Feng's vision went dark, and she really wanted to faint.
"Come with me!" Mrs. Feng gave Jiang Ancheng a gouging look and hurried to the flower hall.
"Second Young Master, you can't go in. There are distinguished guests inside."
Jiang Zhan jumped three feet high: "Oh my god, what kind of distinguished guest? Who is a distinguished guest who insults my sister? Get out of my way!"
Jiang Zhan kicked the maid who was standing in front of him, showing no sympathy for her.
Guo, the wife of Duke Anguo, was already stunned.
"Are you from Duke Anguo's mansion?"
Guo couldn't help but stood up. If she hadn't seen that the young man who rushed over was really good-looking and couldn't get along with the bandits, she would have run away long ago.
"I am the wife of Duke An Guo. Who are you? How can youSo rude? ” Guo tried to reason with the beautiful boy.
When Jiang Zhan heard that he was a heavyweight and he was caught in his own home, it would be useless if he didn't beat him, so he picked up the small table at his feet and smashed it over.
Guo screamed, rolled her eyes and was about to faint.
The maid at the door shouted: "Mrs. Prince, you can't faint. We, the Second Young Master, can't stop us from making trouble——"
When Mrs. Guo heard this, she trembled. Her head was no longer dizzy, her legs were no longer trembling, and she ran away.
The waiter hit the corner of the table with a loud noise, and the corner of the table immediately broke.
Jiang Zhan carried Xiao Ji and chased after him: "Stop, you bullied my sister and you still want to run away? "
"Little beast, what are you doing? Mrs. Feng hurried over and was so angry that she saw Jiang Zhan running after Mr. Guo.
Guo took a breath.
Finally, Mrs. Dongping arrived.
A soft girl's voice came: "Mrs. Prince, you'd better go back to your house as soon as possible. The old lady can't control the second young master if he goes crazy. Even if he is punished later, the damage caused at that time cannot be undone. "
